additional_info.subject: RE: ID0373871-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R4 170001710] OCPP Offline CRM:00797001164
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-FR T
eam,
We checked the XF4 router via SSH and found that the SIM card status is "SIM (Not Inserted)" with WAN failover for the Wi-Fi network enabled. We disabled the WAN failover and rebooted the router, but the SIM card status remains "SIM (Not Inserted).
It might be a hardware issue. If so, the problem could be with,
SIM card
SIM card tray
Router itself
Please plan an onsite visit to check these components. We recommend carrying a spare router and replacing it if necessary.
